# App closed (`app_closed`)

**Kind:** trigger · **Category:** Apps · **Available in:** personal and machine automations

Fires when an app exits.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `app` | app or list of apps | yes |  | The app(s) that close. Use the exe name (chrome or chrome.exe), a full path (C:\Games\game.exe) or wildcards (*steam*). Use * for any app. |
| `instance` | one of: `last`, `any` | no | `last` | 'last' fires only when the last running copy exits (the app is fully closed); 'any' fires for every process that exits. |
| `user` | user or list of users | no |  | Only fire when one of these users close the app. Accepts a user name (samet), DOMAIN\name, a SID, or wildcards (admin*). Leave empty for any user. |

## Example

```yaml
triggers:
  - type: app_closed
    app: obs64.exe
```
